panels.description: FULL-PAGE DAWN IMAGE. Older Alex, his granddaughter and crooked TJ stand above restored Lake Keel. The damaged component rests in the granddaughter's hand. Old mine walls, terraces, gardens, workshops and control nodes recede into the bright basin. Leave clear sky at upper left for the first balloon and open lake at upper right for the second.

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: You really don’t know who owns the water?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: I know who keeps showing up for it.
